name: Nibbled-On Book

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit in Elwynn Forest, you help secure Northshire Valley by recovering property stolen from Northshire Abbey.
As a human, you share an interest in Northshire Abbey's library, which preserves clerical and historical knowledge for the kingdom of Stormwind.

aliases: what book did the kobold drop
faq.answer: Kobolds stole the volume from Northshire Abbey. Its cover bears tooth marks, as though the scavengers mistook its parchment and leather binding for food.
The tooth marks suggest the kobolds tried to chew or eat the book. They scavenge what they find, and Brother Paxton says they steal his books to gnaw on them.
faq.q: Why did the kobolds try to eat the book?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton is a cleric at Northshire Abbey who cares for its modest library. Kobolds sneaking into the abbey and taking books from his shelves distress him.

aliases: where did the book come from
faq.answer: The book came from the small library Brother Paxton keeps inside Northshire Abbey, in Northshire Valley of Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Where did the book originally come from?

faq.answer: Yes. Brother Paxton worries that kobolds have repeatedly stolen from his shelves. He wonders what to do about the rest of his missing collection.
faq.q: Are there other missing books from the abbey's library?

aliases: how to get the book back
faq.answer: Return the recovered book to Brother Paxton inside Northshire Abbey. He inspects its tooth-marked cover and takes it back into his care.
faq.q: Who should the book be returned to?

sections.body: Kobolds in Northshire Valley scavenge what they find left unguarded. You recover a chewed tome from a slain kobold, its cover torn and its parchment marked by teeth. The book came from the library shelves of nearby Northshire Abbey. Valley kobolds have been taking volumes from there.
sections.title: A Chewed Tome

sections.body: Brother Paxton tends the small library inside Northshire Abbey, where the Brotherhood of Northshire reads and studies. Kobolds from the valley slip inside and snatch books from the shelves. Paxton is grateful to have this nibbled volume back. Yet he worries about the rest of his collection still missing in kobold hands.
sections.title: Brother Paxton's Plight

summary: In Northshire Valley, Nibbled-On Book has been chewed by kobolds. Brother Paxton hopes to see it returned to Northshire Abbey's modest collection.
